newsitem.title: USA: Leona Helmsley selling off real estate.
newsitem.headline: Leona Helmsley selling off real estate.

text.p: Leona Helmsley, widow of the late New York real estate mogul Harry Helmsley, is offering for sale a portion of the family's multibillion-dollar real estate empire.
Eastdil Realty Co LLC, a real estate investment banking company chosen by Helmsley to handle the sale, valued the properties at over $5 billion.
"She said that she can't handle all those properties and wanted to sell some of them," said Helmsley spokesman Howard Rubenstein. "And they are all prime properties."

For sale are over 25 million square feet of properties nationwide, including 20,000 residential units, over 7,500 hotel rooms, 50 separate retail projects, office buildings, and over eight million square feet of warehouses, garages, unimproved land and other properties.
Eastdil Chairman Ben Lambert said Helmsley was selling into a strong real estate market, adding, "We hope that the results will be very very good for Mrs. Helmsley."
